bagPolicy.summary: Bags must not exceed 12” x 6” x 12”. Small clutch bags up to 6"x9" are allowed. Backpacks and multi-compartment bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There are various parking decks available around The Battery, with the Orange and Delta decks being the closest to the venue. On Braves game days, parking availability may vary.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Coca-Cola Roxy's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Coca-Cola Roxy offers a variety of late-night bites including classic options like fries, hot dogs, and grilled cheese, as well as specialty items such as a Smash Burger and Crispy Chicken Po'Boy. The EP Lounge features exclusive dishes like Braised Short Rib Hoagie and Jack and Coke Glazed Pork Belly. The kitchen closes at 9:00 PM.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices. Coca-Cola Roxy's Accessible section on the floor is located in front of the stage on the right side of the venue.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Coca-Cola Roxy's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Coca-Cola Roxy. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Coca-Cola Roxy. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
